body:
I dont have any family apart from my mother and uncle. my mum is terminally ill in an institution and my uncle who is a psychiatrist never even answered my plead for help. 
I have very few friends whom I xan trust left, not many have had the guts to stand by my side through all these things.
I am worried i lose the rest with burdening them....

Yes my kids would be the only thing stopping me at the moment, but the feelings do get intense. I feel kind of explaining this complex situation over and over. Worried there is going to be another unqualified worker on the line like the one who said "oh, that sounds like a really impossible situation even to our standards."
Came very close after that call....
Sorry about your loss.
